Title: SQL Database Managed Instance Business Critical GUID changes

Body.Content:
Effective December 1, 2018, resource GUIDs for Azure SQL Database Managed Instance Business Critical will change to simplify billing practices. The changes to the resource GUIDs will affect the region name and product names.

These changes will not affect how the service operates. If you are reporting on region names or resource GUIDs, you will need to modify your reports.

View the following table for detailed changes.
